items.question: What's the difference between sway and dance?
items.answer: The sway filter creates gentle, rhythmic side-to-side movement — more like a slow dance or gentle rocking. Regular dance templates have more energetic, complex choreography. Sway is calmer and more aesthetic.

items.question: Which sway template should I choose?
items.answer: Gentle Sway has the subtlest movement, perfect for portraits. Romantic Sway adds slightly more motion with a dreamy quality. Sway Filter is the classic TikTok effect with moderate movement.

items.question: Does the sway filter work with non-human subjects?
items.answer: Yes! The sway filter is the most versatile effect we offer. It works beautifully with pet photos, artwork, landscapes, and even product photos. Any image can benefit from the gentle motion.

items.question: Why do sway videos get so many views?
items.answer: The hypnotic, looping motion keeps viewers watching multiple times. TikTok and Instagram algorithms detect this high watch-time and push the content to more viewers, creating a viral loop.

items.question: Can I use the sway filter for business content?
items.answer: Absolutely. The sway filter is popular for product showcases, brand aesthetics, and professional content. The gentle motion adds visual interest without being distracting.
